OAKLAND MUNICIPAL CODE

§ 1950.5 Security Deposits and Tenant Protections
A landlord may not demand or receive security, however denominated, in an amount or value in excess of
one month's rent for an unfurnished residential property.

Section 8.22.030 Rent Adjustment Program Notice
Landlords must provide tenants with written notice of the Rent Adjustment Program at the commencement of tenancy.
Failure to serve this notice tolls the statute of limitations on rent disputes.

Section 8.22.360 Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance
A landlord shall not endeavor to recover possession of a rental unit except upon one of the enumerated Just Cause grounds.
